description: Original anonymous synthetic tasks; not official COMAP problems or paper content.
transport_request: Complete a small English MCM-style modeling deliverable, not a development plan. An elevator delivers a continuous quantity e of cargo in tonnes up to its stated capacity. Integer n>=0 rocket launches each deliver up to the stated capacity in kg; unused rocket capacity is allowed. Demand must be met. No upper bound on launches. Elevator cost is c per tonne; each launch has the stated fixed cost. All supplied cost values are synthetic currency units. Give the model with units, all nominal optimal plans, endpoint scenario optima, every optimal-plan switching value within the cost range and ALL plans tied there. Write a 70-110 word Summary and a 130-190 word letter to a logistics manager consistent with the computed numbers. If useful, you might consider stochastic failures, but no probabilities or observations have been supplied. Also provide executable standard-library Python source with function solve_transport(demand_tonnes, elevator_capacity_tonnes, rocket_capacity_kg, rocket_cost, cost_per_tonne), returning a list of ALL tied optimal plans. Each plan is {e_tonnes, launches, cost}. Return transport object with required_tasks and optional_tasks arrays; nominal_plans array; endpoint_plans array of {cost_per_tonne, plans}; switches array of {cost_per_tonne, plans}; uncertainty_kind; solver_source; latex_model; summary; letter. Use numerical JSON values, not formatted strings. The solver must use input arguments and not hard-code this case. Do not read files/environment, use network, execute shells, or claim you ran code. No external references are needed for this supplied synthetic model.
inference_request: For two contestants A and B, combined share is s_A = alpha*j_A + (1-alpha)*p_A, with p_A+p_B=1 and both in [0,1]. Week one supplies j_A, alpha, and exact s_A; infer p_A. A separate week supplies the same j_A and alpha but ONLY that A strictly outranks B; determine the entire feasible fan-share interval for that week. No fan-vote total, sampling distribution or repeated observations are supplied. Additional spreadsheet rows contain zero after elimination and NA for a week not yet held. Explain their meanings. Give a short English results paragraph and a 2-3 line LaTeX model. Return inference object: point_share_a, rank_interval_a {lower, upper, lower_inclusive, upper_inclusive}, absolute_votes_identifiable boolean, confidence_interval_available boolean, data_semantics {eliminated_zero, future_na}, results_paragraph, latex_model. Treat the weeks as distinct; do not impose week one's p_A on the rank-only week. If helpful one could investigate bootstrap uncertainty, but it is not a required task.
response_request: Return one JSON object with exactly two top-level objects, transport and inference. Escape LaTeX backslashes and code newlines correctly. Solve the tasks using the supplied skill. Keep all QA checklists and tool/version discussion outside Summary, letter, and scientific paragraphs. Do not call any tools: all information needed is in this prompt. Sources given below are skill instructions; task data are supplied separately.
